parameters.name: MessageType
parameters.description: The Message type of a message received from this IEEE1905Device that contained a Vendor specific TLV, as defined in {{bibref|IEEE1905.1a|Table 6-4: Message type}}.

parameters.name: OUI
parameters.description: This is the value of the Vendor specific OUI defined in {{bibref|IEEE1905.1a|Table 6-7: Vendor specific TLV}}. {{pattern}}

parameters.name: Information
parameters.description: A hexbinary string used to provide vendor specific information. This is the value of the Vendor specific information parameter defined in {{bibref|IEEE1905.1a|Table 6-7: Vendor specific TLV}}.

object.description: This object represents vendor specific information received in a message with a Vendor specific TLV (as defined in in {{bibref|IEEE1905.1a|Table 6-7: Vendor specific TLV}}).
